overloads.semanticRole: Overwrites a run of characters in source starting at a given position with newChars, returning the result at source's original length.

constraints: If newChars is an empty string, source is returned unchanged.
If where is less than 1 or greater than the length of source, source is returned unchanged.
Always returns a string of the same length as source (overlays characters starting at where rather than inserting them, unlike Insert string).
